static bool wm_ipad_knife_precision_pan_.text:
static bool wm_ipad_knife_precision_pan_event_context(bContext *C, const wmEvent *event)
{
  /* This source classification proves neither an accepted press nor an owner.
   * Emulated MMB can outlive modifier changes without a held-button receipt. */
  return C && event && CTX_py_dict_get(C) == nullptr &&
         (U.flag & USER_TWOBUTTONMOUSE) == 0 && wm_eventemulation_mouse == EVENT_NONE &&
         (event->flag & WM_EVENT_IS_PENCIL_PRECISION_PAN) != 0 &&
         (event->flag & (WM_EVENT_MULTITOUCH_TWO_FINGERS | WM_EVENT_MULTITOUCH_THREE_FINGERS |
                         WM_EVENT_IS_TOUCH_PINCH | WM_EVENT_IS_POINTER_CANCEL |
                         WM_EVENT_IS_DIRECT_TOOL | WM_EVENT_IS_DIRECT_FINGER)) == 0 &&
         event->type == MOUSEPAN && event->val == KM_NOTHING &&
         event->modifier == KM_CTRL && event->keymodifier == EVENT_NONE &&
         wm_ipad_knife_precision_pan_owner_context(C);
}
